attributes.context: Article XI, 'Retraining and/or Reassignment,' provides a retraining/reassignment response to layoffs or contemplated layoffs caused by automation, mechanization, plant expansion, or changes in plant technology, with eligibility based on two or more full years of continuous service and subsequent provisions on pay, training resources, make-up periods, grievance handling, and local program rules.

extraction_text: When employees are faced with layoffs or contemplated layoffs caused by automation, mechanization or other reasons and in cases of contemplated plant expansions or changes in plant technology or otherwise, employees with two or more full years of continuous service may be retrained and/or reassigned to acquire necessary skills for jobs requiring such skills. An employee may decline any such offer of a retraining and/or reassignment opportunity and may elect to exercise his regular transfer rights under the contract and local supplements and procedures. Either the employee or local management may discontinue the arrangement at any time. In the event of discontinuance, the employee shall have the right to exercise his regular transfer rights at that time in accordance with the terms of the National Agreement and the applicable local supplement.

attributes.context: This clause is located under the heading ‘3. Retraining and Readjustment Assistance’ and the subheading ‘(a) Rate Guarantee,’ appearing after plant closing, employment assistance, and education/retraining provisions in the same chunk.

extraction_text: An hourly rated or nonexempt salaried employee whose job is directly eliminated by a transfer of work, the discontinuance of a discrete, unreplaced product line, the introduction of a robot, or the introduction of an automated manufacturing or office machine shall be paid on any job to which transterred or recalled in the plant at a rate not less than the regular hourly daywork rate (average earnings exclusive of overtime premium in the case of incentive workers and actual straight-time salary rate in the case of nonexempt salaried employees) of the job eliminated for up to seventy-eight (78) weeks immediately following the original transfer or layoff.

attributes.context: This is part of Section 3(b) Special Retirement Bonus, which also provides that the election is made within 15 days, designates eligible employees by seniority, and sets the bonus at $14,000.

extraction_text: An hourly rated or nonexempt salaried employee who is age sixty (60) or older with fifteen (15) or more years of continuous service and is assigned to a job classification which the Company has announced is expected to be directly adversely affected by a transfer of work, the discontinuance of a discrete, unreplaced product line, the introduction of a robot, or the introduction of an automated manufacturing or office machine may elect to be considered for termination with a Special Retirement Bonus.

attributes.context: This deadline follows the Special Retirement Bonus election for employees in job classifications directly adversely affected by an announced transfer, product discontinuance, robot introduction, or automated machine introduction.

extraction_text: This election shall be made within fifteen (15) days following the Company announcement of its decision involving the transfer of work, the discontinuance of a discrete, unreplaced product line, introduction of a robot, or introduction of an automated manufacturing or office machine which is expected to result in the elimination of certain jobs.

attributes.context: This is the procedure for the Special Retirement Bonus, which is $14,000 and is available to hourly rated or nonexempt salaried employees age 60 or older with at least 15 years continuous service.

extraction_text: A termination under this option will be effective and the Special Retirement Bonus will be paid when a job in the particular job classification to which the eligible employee is assigned is directly eliminated by the previously announced transfer of work, the discontinuance of a discrete, unreplaced product line, introduction of a robot, or introduction of an automated manufacturing or office machine which directly results in a net reduction in the total number of employees working in that same job classification.

attributes.context: This indirect bonus eligibility follows the Special Retirement Bonus option and requires the employee to be in a classification reduced due to displacement from the announced action and to meet the criteria in Section 4(c).

extraction_text: In the event the number of eligible employees electing this option is less than the number of employees directly adversely affected by the Company's announced action, opportunities to elect Special Voluntary Layoff Bonus under Section 4(c) shall arise, up to the number of positions directly adversely affected by the transfer of work, the discontinuance of a discrete, unreplaced product line, or the introduction of an automated manufacturing or office machine.

attributes.context: This is Section 3(c)(1) Special Placement Procedure, which requires the request within two working days after notification and provides placement or displacement with seniority on available jobs under the following subsections.

extraction_text: An hourly rated or non-exempt salaried employee whose job is directly eliminated by a transfer of work, the discontinuance of a discrete, unreplaced product line, the introduction of a robot, or the introduction of an automated manufacturing machine or office machine may request a Special Placement from the eliminated job in lieu of placement, displacement or lay-off under the regular local layoff and rehiring procedure.

attributes.context: This optional local retraining and placement agreement is triggered by the same announced work transfers, product line discontinuances, robot introductions, or automated machine introductions described in the preceding sections.

extraction_text: Whenever the Company announces a transfer of work, the discontinuance of a discrete, unreplaced product line, the introduction of a robot or the introduction of an automated manufacturing or office machine, the Local Union and local management may negotiate a Local Retraining and Placement Agreement.

attributes.context: The surrounding chunk describes Preferential Placement as a benefit available to eligible employees displaced by job elimination, including through robots or automated machines, and sets out the election procedure, placement standards, and benefits available while in Preferential Placement status.

extraction_text: An hourly rated or nonexempt salaried employee eligible for: (i) Severance Pay under Section 2 or (ii) Income Extension Aid ("IEA") resulting from being displaced and subject to layoff in the immediate chain of displacement resulting when a job is directly eliminated by a transfer of work, the discontinuation of a discrete, unreplaced product line, the introduction of a robot, or the introduction of an automated manufacturing or office machine may elect, prior to the employee's termination for plant closing or layoff, and up to thirty (30) days thereafter (except where the laid off employee has elected to receive his IEA in lump sum), to be placed in a Preferential Placement status.

attributes.context: The same section proceeds to detail notice, bargaining, and information obligations for plant closings and transfer of ongoing production work, but the provided text does not separately specify notice, bargaining, or information requirements for the installation of robots or automated manufacturing or office machines.

extraction_text: This Section sets forth the full obligations of the Company with regard to notice, bargaining with and information to the Union concerning plant closing, work transfer, subcontracting and the installation of robots or automated manufacturing or office machines.

attributes.context: The same CBA chunk also requires written notice for subcontracting work and establishes job preservation steering committees that may discuss training for anticipated technology changes.

extraction_text: With respect to the installation of robots or automated manufacturing or office machines, the Company will give a minimum of sixty (60) days' notice to the Local involved before the use of a robot or an automated manufacturing or office machine in a work area. Such notice will include a description of the function of the device, identification of the work involved, the expected decrease in the number of represented employees as a direct consequence of the use of the device and the anticipated date of the use of the device.

attributes.context: The preceding sentence in the same section acknowledges that subcontracting work and the introduction of enhanced technology may reduce General Electric Company jobs, and later sentences set quarterly meeting frequency, representative limits, and compensation for committee representatives.

extraction_text:
In order to balance competitive realities with the Union's interest in protecting jobs, the Company and Union will establish a joint Job Preservation Steering Committee at each Company location employing over 50 bargaining unit employees to meet and discuss issues such as:

• Opportunities for job creation

• Potential plant closing, outsourcing/subcontracting and work transfers, including situations where there is no direct decrease in the number of represented employees

• Training for anticipated technology changes

• Work practices and local agreements to increase efficiency

• Investment plans and potential impact on jobs

attributes.context: This provision appears under the section heading 'Installation of Robots or Automated Manufacturing or Office Machines' and follows subcontracting notice and bargaining provisions in the same CBA chunk.
